name: R021-immunity-poison-fang
why: The player's Mightyena (set 202, Poison Fang in slot 1) uses Poison Fang on the opponent's lead Zangoose (set 240, Immunity) for four turns; then Arbok (set 217, Poison Fang in slot 0, the first replacement) keeps using Poison Fang. Poison Fang without STAB from Mightyena does about a fifth of Zangoose's HP, so several hits land before Zangoose faints, and each hit that leaves Zangoose standing has a 30% roll of the bad-poison effect; that roll reaches SetMoveEffect's toxic case, where the Immunity test runs (not primary, not certain, so no prevention script). Both player Pokemon have Intimidate, so Zangoose hits softer. Risk: Zangoose's Roar (1 in 4 per turn at challenge 1) pulls in a random player Pokemon; Wigglytuff (set 207) then uses Disable or Sing, which does no harm.
